transactions.desc: Culpepper (hand) was activated from Triple-A St. Paul's 7-day injured list Friday, Aaron Gleeman of AaronGleeman.com reports.
The Pirates selected Ross's contract from Triple-A Indianapolis on Friday.
Pittsburgh designated Urquidy for assignment Friday.
The Athletics recalled Morales from Triple-A Las Vegas on Friday.
The Guardians optioned Dion to Triple-A Columbus on Friday, Tim Stebbins of MLB.com reports.
The Guardians optioned Schneemann to Triple-A Columbus on Friday, Tim Stebbins of MLB.com reports.
The Guardians activated Herrin (elbow) from the 15-day injured list Friday, Tim Stebbins of MLB.com reports.
The Guardians activated Martinez (foot) from the 10-day injured list Friday, Tim Stebbins of MLB.com reports.
The Phillies selected Henry's contract from Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Friday.
The Cubs recalled Triantos from Triple-A Iowa on Friday.
The Royals optioned Morgan to Triple-A Omaha on Friday.
The Orioles recalled Walker from Triple-A Norfolk on Friday.
The Brewers designated Shewmake for assignment Friday, Hunter Baumgardt of Fox Sports 920 Milwaukee reports.
The Brewers reinstated Hamilton (hamstring) from the 10-day injured list Friday, Hunter Baumgardt of Fox Sports 920 Milwaukee reports.
The Cubs optioned Alcantara to Triple-A Iowa on Thursday.
The Pirates optioned Murdock to Triple-A Indianapolis on Thursday.
The Marlins optioned Brzykcy to Triple-A Jacksonville on Friday.
The Marlins activated King (ankle) from the 15-day injured list Thursday.
The Athletics optioned Tur to Triple-A Las Vegas on Thursday.
Arias will be promoted to Triple-A Worcester, Tommy Cassell of the Worcester Telegram & Gazette reports.
Haase was placed on unconditional release waivers by the Giants on Thursday, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
The San Diego Padres traded RHP Ron Marinaccio to the Pittsburgh Pirates.
The Pirates designated Santana for assignment Thursday, Colin Beazley of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.
The Orioles designated Rodriguez for assignment Thursday, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.
The Orioles claimed Pozo off waivers from the Cardinals on Thursday, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.
The Blue Jays claimed Martin off waivers from the Orioles on Thursday, Ari Alexander of 7 News Boston reports.
The Blue Jays optioned Keys to Triple-A Buffalo on Thursday.
The Blue Jays recalled Macko from Triple-A Buffalo on Thursday.
The Blue Jays recalled Schneider from Triple-A Buffalo on Thursday.
The Rays activated Scholtens (wrist) from the 15-day injured list Thursday and optioned him to Triple-A Durham.
